sources.version: Draft of August 19, 2026; PDF SHA-256 4c49ef5fd5ee99cd4e01d8c755662756daf701bbe3db4da5abf693a64485e60f
sources.authority_reason: 作者在 Stanford 官方網頁提供的原版學術教材，直接定義 n-gram 與訓練／留出評估。
sources.inspection_note: 實讀 §3.1.1 p.3 Eq.(3.7) bigram 只條件於前一位置；§3.2 pp.7–9 將訓練與留出資料分開，指出單一文件與過小留出集不能代表廣泛效能。教材將單位由 word 換成字元；不把此來源當作本專案切分已執行的證據。

sources.title: Bengio et al., A Neural Probabilistic Language Model
sources.version: JMLR 3 (2003), pp.1137–1155; publisher PDF
sources.authority_reason: JMLR 出版方提供該方法的原始論文全文。
sources.inspection_note: 實讀 §2 pp.1141–1143：C 是 |V|×m 的可學特徵表；context 特徵拼接為 x，再經 tanh hidden 與 output；Eq.(1) y=b+Wx+U tanh(d+Hx)，本課相當於無直接連線 W=0。p.1142 說明參數隨 order 線性增加。只核機制與維度關係，不以此論文證明本課 toy 品質。

sources.title: T.3 transparent numerical and logical checks
sources.details: 4 colors × 3 shapes = 12 documents. int(12×0.8)=9, int(12×0.9)=10 gives 9/1/2 complete-document partitions. V=15 training characters+2 controls=17. Bigram parameters=17×17=289. MLP parameters=17×16+(16T×16+16)+(16×17+17)=577+256T, giving 833/1345/1857 at T=1/3/5. In the byte tokenizer A has ASCII/UTF-8 value65, then8 controls offset gives73; EOS is fixed2. The hand-written [73,2] contains2 new tokens and decodes to A; it is not model output. Δ=after−before is negative exactly when after<before. Removing EOS during decoding maps [73] and [73,2] to the same A, hence visible text alone cannot distinguish their stops.
